verses.text: And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:

segments.text: And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:

verses.text: “Dominion and dread [are] with Him, the One making peace in His high places.

segments.text: “Dominion and dread [are] with Him, the One making peace in His high places.

verses.text: Is there a number to His troops? And upon whom does His light not arise?

segments.text: Is there a number to His troops? And upon whom does His light not arise?

verses.text: So how can a man be righteous with God? Or what can be pure [that] is born of a woman?

segments.text: So how can a man be righteous with God? Or what can be pure [that] is born of a woman?

verses.text: Behold, even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His eyes.

segments.text: Behold, even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His eyes.

verses.text: How much less a man—a maggot, and a son of man—a worm!”
